expectations.says: The anaesthesia layer writes both entries, so the anaesthetic has two systolic rows with the same time and value.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings, COUNT(DISTINCT m.measurement_datetime) AS times FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.anaesthetic a ON a.anaesthetic_id = m.measurement_event_id JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000731' AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3004249
